data.name: Leem
data.gender_notes: Leem is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Leem means 'a garden, oasis, or paradise'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'l-m-m', which signifies 'gardens'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes a nurturing, peaceful, and prosperous environment. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, 'Paradise is a garden in which my Ummah will enter and find in it rivers, palm trees, and cool shade.' (Bukhari)
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the blessings and peace found in the Islamic faith
data.etymology: Leem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A garden, oasis, or paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leem total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
